title: Diagnose the approved Terraform backend state without mutation
expected_outcome: Read-only backend metadata and Terraform state-address evidence distinguish an empty/misaddressed state from a managed baseline state, without retrieving or recording sensitive state values.
constraints: Use only S3 object listing/head metadata, STS identity/role reads, and Terraform state-address listing. Do not print, download, persist, or commit raw state; do not write a state lock, apply, refresh, or mutate AWS/Vault/EKS/GitHub/ECR.
Use the existing approved temporary-role profile if present; do not create or alter credentials/profiles.

external_actions: read AWS STS identity and assume existing approved Terraform role through its configured profile
read S3 state bucket object metadata and prefix listing
read Terraform remote state addresses with state locking disabled

primary_owner.responsibility: state-access minimization, evidence review, and conclusion

delegations.escalation_trigger: raw state or any write would be needed

validation: Terraform state address list with lock disabled
